scripts.dev: infisical run --env=dev --path=/survei-kemenag -- npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:no-air: infisical run --env=dev --path=/survei-kemenag -- npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && go run main.go" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: infisical run --env=dev --path=/survei-kemenag -- cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:local: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && go build -o bin/server main.go
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
